errors.evidence: The text “名词词频” is the label for the y-axis, not a separate caption (图注) for the figure. The description itself correctly identifies it as the y-axis label later on ("纵轴为数值轴，标签为“词频”"), creating a contradiction.

errors.text_span: 约在 20 左右（略高于或接近 20）
errors.evidence: The bars on the far right of the chart have values closer to 25. Describing them as being around 20 is an underestimate.
